<b>The Lost Merchant</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired from [[Songclave|Songclave's]] [[Wishwall]] after completing 5 Wishes from it, including <i>[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> and <i>[[Strengthening Songclave]]</i>. [[Jubilana]] must also have been spoken to before, and the [[Faydown Cloak]] needs to have been obtained.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall's location in Songclave
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Songclave
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must find Jubilana's location within the southeast part of the [[Memorium]]. Jubilana's wares are scattered around the Memorium, which can be interacted with to track her pathway.

At this location, Jubilana is hiding from two [[Drapefly|Drapeflies]] and one [[Drapelord]]. After defeating this group, another group consisting of two Drapelords and two Drapeflies spawns, which has to be defeated to save her and return her to Songclave.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana The Lost Merchant.png!Jubilana's location in the Memorium
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 03.png!Jubilana in the Memorium
}}

== Reward ==
After completing the Wish, Jubilana expands her shop inventory with the [[Spider Strings]], a [[Spool Fragment]], [[Craftmetal]], and a [[Choral Commandment]].
